clips.title: The story
paras: During the Lunar Festival, Graveborn the Elder waits near Brill in Tirisfal Glades. Travelers seek him among the blighted groves to honor Azeroth’s ancient forebears, and receive his blessing and a holiday token.

In Tirisfal Glades, the Forsaken live among ruined manors and grave sites. During the Lunar Festival, a spirit from ancient times appears just outside Brill. Elder Graveborn welcomes pilgrims who pause to honor the old ways, even in a land shattered by the Scourge and reclaimed by the undead.

During the Lunar Festival, spirits from long-past eras return with wisdom and gratitude. When you approach Elder Graveborn, he says it heartens him that Tirisfal’s people still honor their ancestors despite the land’s decay. He gives a Coin of Ancestry to those who greet him.

clips.title: Completion
paras: It is good to know the people of this land still pay homage to the olden races. I bid you well, friend, and offer you this token...
